detail.readme: # LightNVR [![License: GPL v3](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-GPLv3-blue.svg)](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0) [![Container Image](https://img.shields.io/badge/container-ghcr.io-blue?logo=docker)](https://github.com/opensensor/lightNVR/pkgs/container/lightnvr) [![Integration Tests](https://github.com/opensensor/lightNVR/actions/workflows/integration-test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/opensensor/lightNVR/actions/workflows/integration-test.yml) [![Static Analysis](https://github.com/opensensor/lightNVR/actions/workflows/static-analysis.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/opensensor/lightNVR/actions/workflows/static-analysis.yml) [![Sanitizer Build](https://github.com/opensensor/lightNVR/actions/workflows/sanitizer.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/opensensor/lightNVR/actions/workflows/sanitizer.yml) [![CodeQL](https://github.com/opensensor/lightNVR/actions/workflows/codeql-analysis.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/opensensor/lightNVR/actions/workflows/codeql-analysis.yml) [![lightnvr-rs](https://github.com/opensensor/lightNVR/actions/workflows/lightnvr-rs.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/opensensor/lightNVR/actions/workflows/lightnvr-rs.yml) **A self-hosted network video recorder that runs on anything from a 256 MB embedded board to a server.** LightNVR records your IP cameras, streams them live to the browser over WebRTC or HLS, and finds what matters with detection zones, ONVIF events and licence plate search — all locally, with no cloud account. ![Live view](docs/images/live-streams.png) > **Free to use does not mean free to build.** About $10,000 of the maintainer's own money > has gone into LightNVR over roughly two years. If it saves you money or supports your > customers, please help through the **[$10K Sustainability Drive](docs/SPONSORSHIP.md)** or > **[sponsor on GitHub](https://github.com/sponsors/matteius)**. ## What it does **Record** - Continuous, scheduled, motion- and detection-triggered recording to standard MP4, with a pre-event buffer so clips include what led up to them - Retention policies, recording protection and tags, and disk-space management - Optional archival to S3, NFS or SAN storage ([storage & archive](docs/STORAGE_ARCHIVE.md)) **Watch** - Live grid over WebRTC (sub-second) or HLS, with detection overlays — proxied and authenticated through LightNVR, built on [go2rtc](https://github.com/AlexxIT/go2rtc) - Recordings browser, a timeline, and an **Investigation** workspace that reviews up to 16 cameras against one shared clock without hiding gaps in footage - Clip and multi-camera export **Detect** - Polygon detection zones with per-zone object classes and confidence thresholds ([zones](docs/ZONE_CONFIGURATION.md)) - External detection through [light-object-detect](https://github.com/opensensor/light-object-detect) (ONNX/TFLite) or [DOODS2](https://github.com/snowzach/doods2), or embedded [SOD](docs/SOD_INTEGRATION.md) for small devices ([detection engines](docs/DETECTION_ENGINES.md)) - ONVIF discovery and camera-side motion events ([ONVIF](docs/ONVIF_DETECTION.md)) - Licence plate reads with plate search **Run it securely** - Database-backed users with roles, TOTP multi-factor authentication and API keys - A forced password change on first login; go2rtc's API kept on loopback - Operational health: OS, container, filesystem and hardware sampling, incidents, and Prometheus metrics ([system health](docs/api/system-health.md)) - Non-root container image with all capabilities dropped **Integrate** - REST API with an in-app API reference ([API](docs/API.md)) - MQTT events and Home Assistant discovery ([MQTT](docs/MQTT_INTEGRATION.md), [Home Assistant](docs/HOME_ASSISTANT.md)) The web UI ships in 19 languages, with light and dark modes and eight colour themes. | ![Detection zone editor](docs/images/zone-editor-demo.png) | ![Recordings](docs/images/recording-management.png) | |:---:|:---:| | Detection zone editor | Recordings | | ![Stream configuration](docs/images/stream-config-detection.png) | ![System](docs/images/system-info.png) | | Per-stream detection settings | System health | ## Quick start ### Docker Compose ```bash mkdir lightnvr && cd lightnvr curl -LO https://raw.githubusercontent.com/opensensor/lightNVR/main/docker-compose.yml docker compose up -d ``` Open `http://:8080`. Images are published to `ghcr.io/opensensor/lightnvr` for `linux/amd64`, `linux/arm64` and `linux/arm/v7` on every release. Volumes, ports, environment variables and upgrades are covered in the [Docker guide](docs/DOCKER.md). ### Other ways to install | | | |---|---| | **Home Assistant** | Add [opensensor/lightnvr-hassio-addons](https://github.com/opensensor/lightnvr-hassio-addons) under *Settings → Add-ons → Add-on Store → ⋮ → Repositories*, then install LightNVR. See [Home Assistant](docs/HOME_ASSISTANT.md). | | **Debian / Ubuntu** | `.deb` packages for amd64, arm64 and armhf are attached to each [release](https://github.com/opensensor/lightNVR/releases). | | **Windows** | [Podman + WSL2](docs/WINDOWS_PODMAN.md) | | **From source** | [Build guide](docs/BUILD.md): FFmpeg ≥ 7.1, Node.js 26, CMake. Required for embedded targets. | ### First login > ⚠️ **The default login is `admin` / `admin`, and the web server listens on all > interfaces.** Until you change the password, anyone who can reach port 8080 can see your > cameras. LightNVR opens a password-change screen on first login and blocks the rest of the UI until you replace the default. To avoid the default ever being valid, set `password` in the `[web]` section of `lightnvr.ini` before the first start. Locked out? See [Authentication issues](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md#authentication-issues). Then add a camera (ONVIF discovery or an RTSP URL), confirm it records, and set a retention policy. The [documentation index](docs/README.md#getting-started) walks through each step. ### Something wrong? - **Blank page** — usually a volume mounted over `/var/lib/lightnvr` instead of `/var/lib/lightnvr/data`. See [web interface troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING_WEB_INTERFACE.md). - **WebRTC won't connect** — set `external_ip` under `[go2rtc]` in `lightnvr.ini` to the host's LAN address. See [WebRTC not working](docs/DOCKER.md#webrtc-not-working). - **Anything else** — the [troubleshooting guide](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md). ## Native C and Rust builds LightNVR is written in C, and **C remains the source of truth**: every feature and fix is made there, and the native builds above come from it. Alongside them, CI translates the C into Rust with [C2Rust](https://github.com/immunant/c2rust) on every pull request, builds it, and runs the smoke and API contract tests against it. This build, **lightnvr-rs**, is for organizations whose policies call for software built in a memory-safe language. Starting with 0.47.3, it is published as `ghcr.io/opensensor/lightnvr-rs` and `lightnvr-rs__sid_amd64.deb`. Today the translation is C-shaped `unsafe` Rust linking the same native libraries, so its safety properties are essentially those of the C build. It is the foundation for removing `unsafe` over time, not a finished safe-Rust port. Contributors never edit [`rust/`](rust/README.md) by hand. The [announcement](https://github.com/opensensor/lightNVR/discussions/874) explains the reasoning. ## Requirements - Linux on ARM, x86 or MIPS (kernel 4.4+) - 256 MB RAM minimum; more for several streams or detection ([memory in practice](docs/INSTALLATION.md#memory-in-practice)) - Cameras that speak RTSP or ONVIF, H.264 or H.265 ([camera notes](docs/CAMERAS.md)) ## Documentation The **[documentation index](docs/README.md)** is grouped by task: install, configure, operate, integrate and develop. Common starting points: - [Installation](docs/INSTALLATION.md) · [Docker](docs/DOCKER.md) · [Configuration](docs/CONFIGURATION.md) · [Reverse proxy & HTTPS](docs/REVERSE_PROXY.md) - [Cameras](docs/CAMERAS.md) · [Detection zones](docs/ZONE_CONFIGURATION.md) · [Storage & archive](docs/STORAGE_ARCHIVE.md) - [REST API](docs/API.md) · [MQTT](docs/MQTT_INTEGRATION.md) · [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) ## Contributing Pull requests are welcome. Make changes in C under `src/` and `include/`, or in the web UI under `web/`. CI regenerates the Rust build for you. On your first pull request, the CLA bot will ask you to sign the [Contributor License Agreement](CLA.md). Report security issues privately as described in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). ## License LightNVR is licensed under the [GNU General Public License v3.0](LICENSE). For proprietary integration or professional support, see [commercial licensing](docs/COMMERCIAL.md). ## Star history ## Acknowledgments LightNVR builds on [FFmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org/), [go2rtc](https://github.com/AlexxIT/go2rtc), [SQLite](https://www.sqlite.org/), [libuv](https://github.com/libuv/libuv), [llhttp](https://github.com/nodejs/llhttp), [cJSON](https://github.com/DaveGamble/cJSON), [Preact](https://preactjs.com/), [Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com/), [HLS.js](https://github.com/video-dev/hls.js/), [SOD](https://github.com/symisc/sod) and [light-object-detect](https://github.com/opensensor/light-object-detect) — and on everyone who has filed an issue, sent a patch or sponsored the work.
